baseline.protocol: Compare pinned upstream runtime and native with identical weights, tokenized prompts, images, sampler, budgets; serial normally admitted GPU runs. Preserve baseline/order/feature ablations. Recheck full-logit parity after any optimization. No quality retry selection.

selected_policy.policy: Request-owned activation graphs for all three Small IDs; signed-Hadamard fusion for short 512 rows and existing 1024 path; 4096 reference path retained after regressions in both model orders

additional_control_plan.purpose: Complete transform x model-order controls after initial fused 4B regression coincided with a nominal-to-fair thermal transition. Preserve every sample; do not select faster cohorts. This cohort was added after observing the first comparison and is not a preregistered primary result.
additional_control_plan.scheduling: After final fused numerical parity to prevent concurrent workloads

initial_vm.reason: New VM5.9GiB;16GiB normal floor retained. Reverse cohort has no measurements. Continue synthetic GPU checks and builds, then resume installed-model benchmarks when headroom returns.

selected_startup.reason: 20 normal-admission startup attempts exhausted before Chrome was quit. Retained entire admission-only folder and restarted in a fresh cohort folder. No timing samples discarded and no thresholds changed.

protocol.decode: Up to64 greedy upstream steps; native uses the identical upstream continuation to compare conditional logits
protocol.interpretation: Report each gate separately; any failure prevents an overall parity claim. Tolerances are frozen before native/reference comparison. No sampled-output equivalence claim.
protocol.reference_prefill_positions: Explicit slices of unmodified upstream full-prompt get_rope_index output for image chunks; default scalar cache offset is only used during decode

component_profiles.scope: Experimental 512/1024/4096 fusion; final 4096 path uses reference after whole-model controls

request_verification.upstream_prompt_ids_match_native: Exact equality asserted in all three passing opt-in XCTest runs

limits: One desktop host, three resident timing samples per modality and cohort; distributions are not sustained-throughput guarantees.
The stacks use their own decode timers; upstream includes detokenization and first-token boundary accounting differs. Loading and prefill are excluded.
Native prefix reuse follows server defaults; upstream uses fresh request caches. Prompt token IDs/counts agree; output samples are unseeded.
Native applies top-k before top-p; upstream applies top-p before top-k. Matching knobs do not imply identical sampling policies.
Python MLX is 0.32.0; native MLX backend is 0.32.1 via its pinned Swift fork. The source fix is separately isolated with an unchanged-binary feature ablation.
Shared admission and sampled process telemetry do not prove every unrelated desktop GPU workload was absent.
The prior 48-case sampled quality run belongs to the previous executable. These changes are checked through the frozen upstream parity gates; sampled quality is not rerun.
